rationale: All 5 blocking findings from the prior review were re-verified against current source (HEAD e7bc72f6c) and are resolved: created_by now typed str | None (CR-001); new_owner resolved via get_active_by_id, rejecting deactivated/soft-deleted accounts (CR-002); the unresolved-new-owner case now raises the same generic PROJECT_NOT_FOUND message/shape used for missing projects, closing the enumeration channel (CR-003); the new owner is now added to user_project_repository as a project admin when not already a member (CR-004); and the PROJECT_OWNERSHIP_CHANGED activity event now carries previous_owner_username/new_owner_username attributes, satisfying the audit-trail gap (CR-005). Matching unit tests exist for each fix. business_review and standards_review are carried forward unchanged from the prior verdict per contract (this round's standards_path is null and review-standards is not re-dispatched on a check round); no new findings were discovered.

standards_review.notes: All 5 commit subjects in range follow the documented 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format from git-workflow.md
code-quality.md prefers 'X | None' over 'typing.Optional[X]'; new created_by: Optional[str] param at application_repository.py:734 doesn't match sibling params using 'X | None'.
Distinct 404 'User not found' vs generic 'Project not found' enables user-id enumeration; new_owner validated via get_by_id (not get_active_by_id), allowing transfer to a deactivated user.

finding_status.notes: application_repository.py:734 now reads 'created_by: str | None = None', matching the sibling parameters' typing style.
project_service.py:297 resolves new_owner via user_repository.get_active_by_id; test_update_project_ownership_deactivated_user_raises_404 confirms a deactivated account is rejected with 404.

project_service.py:299 now raises cls.ERRORS.PROJECT_NOT_FOUND (the same generic message used for a missing project) when new_owner_id does not resolve, instead of a distinct 'User not found' message.

project_service.py:313-319 adds the new owner to user_project_repository as a project admin when not already a member; test_update_project_ownership_adds_new_owner_as_project_member and test_update_project_ownership_skips_membership_add_when_already_member cover both branches.

project_service.py:328-331 now includes previous_owner_username/new_owner_username in the PROJECT_OWNERSHIP_CHANGED activity event attributes, resolving the audit-identification gap the finding raised.
